notes:
Treatment-by-STK11 interaction on overall survival, MSK-CHORD. TIME ORIGIN NOTE: empirically established that OS in this export is measured from the SEQUENCING date (day 0 of the treatment timeline), not from diagnosis -- 99.7% of patients whose first treatment preceded sequencing by >8.2y have OS shorter than that interval, which is impossible under a diagnosis anchor. This governs the entire design: entry is left-truncated at max(0, treatment_start) so that patients sequenced before starting therapy contribute no immortal time.

PRE-SPECIFIED DECISION RULE (fixed before any outcome was read). Cells are 93/587/74/385 (ICI-mut / ICI-wt / chemo-mut / chemo-wt), confirmed by dry run. Achievable equivalence margins by assumed event fraction: f=0.5: SE(log ROR)=0.239, achievable TOST margin=1.81; f=0.6: SE(log ROR)=0.218, achievable TOST margin=1.72; f=0.7: SE(log ROR)=0.202, achievable TOST margin=1.65; f=0.8: SE(log ROR)=0.189, achievable TOST margin=1.60. THE EQUIVALENCE MARGIN IS PRESPECIFIED AT 1.70 and will not be moved after seeing the estimate. DECISION RULE: (a) if the 95% CI for the ratio-of-hazard-ratios lies entirely within 1/1.70 to 1.70, conclude EQUIVALENCE -- the treatment-by-STK11 interaction is bounded, supporting the prognostic reading; (b) if the CI excludes 1.0, conclude a treatment-by-STK11 INTERACTION EXISTS, supporting the predictive reading; (c) otherwise conclude INCONCLUSIVE and report it as inconclusive, NOT as a null. Outcome (c) is an expected and acceptable result and will be reported as prominently as (a) or (b). The published benchmark this must beat to contribute is Papillon-Cavanagh 2020, OS interaction 95% CI 0.76-1.67; if the resulting interval is wider than that, the honest conclusion is that this cohort adds an independent modern-era estimate but does not narrow the published uncertainty, and that will be stated.

filters.note: advanced/metastatic at some point; Stage 1-3 excluded because first-line systemic therapy there is frequently adjuvant, a different population with different prognosis, and adjuvant ICI was not standard for most of this era -- including them would load the chemotherapy arm with resected patients
EGFR/ALK-altered patients receive targeted therapy and are not part of the ICI-vs-platinum decision
incident-user window, upper bound; avoids prevalent-user selection in which patients treated long before sequencing are conditioned on having survived to be sequenced

exposure.note: Loss-of-function only. Missense/VUS deliberately excluded: the mechanism requires abolished kinase activity, and diluting the exposure with variants of unknown significance was available as a power gain and refused.

modifier.name: treatment_is_ici
modifier.note: 1 = first-line regimen contains an anti-PD-1/PD-L1 agent; 0 = first-line platinum doublet without one. Later-line ICI is permitted in the comparator (ITT-style): requiring 'never ICI' would exclude precisely those chemotherapy patients who survived long enough to reach second line, selecting the comparator arm toward short survivors.
